name: settling_velocity
description: Still-water settling velocity (Ferguson & Church 2004), per grain from its equivalent diameter. Baked-in constants: quartz in seawater (submerged specific gravity R=1.58), C1=18, C2=1.0 (natural angular grains), kinematic viscosity 1.19e-6 m2/s (seawater ~15C). Edit this addon for other lithologies / fluids.

name: dimensionless_grain_size
description: Dimensionless grain size D* = (R g / nu^2)^(1/3) * D. Controls the Shields threshold regime. Constants as for settling_velocity (quartz, seawater 15C).

name: critical_shear_stress
description: Critical (threshold-of-motion) bed shear stress to entrain the grain, tau_c = theta_c (rho_s - rho_f) g D, with a constant Shields parameter theta_c=0.045 (gravel) and (rho_s - rho_f)=1623 kg/m3 (quartz in seawater). Edit theta_c / densities for other settings.

name: critical_shear_velocity
description: Critical bed shear velocity u*_c = sqrt(tau_c / rho_f) at the threshold of motion (same constants as critical_shear_stress; rho_f=1027 kg/m3 seawater).

name: corey_shape_factor
description: Corey shape factor c/sqrt(a*b) under the imagery-only assumption that the unmeasured thickness c equals the minor plan-view axis b, which reduces to sqrt(b/a). 1 = spherical, lower = more platy/elongate.

name: grain_roughness_ks
description: Per-grain Nikuradse roughness proxy k_s = 2.5 D. Mapped per cell (e.g. as a median) it approximates the hydraulic bed roughness; for a bed-scale estimate use the D84-based form on the rasterised grain-size surface.
